_meta.description: Human-readable mirror of src/lib/compass/planningEvidence.ts. Every value used by the surgical-plan, inflammation-risk, healer-tier and BCR-by-plan modules, tagged by source. The TypeScript file is the runtime source of truth.

sources.institutional: derived from the Mount Sinai RARP cohort / an existing fitted COMPASS model
sources.provisional: expert-prior default not yet calibrated on COMPASS data; flagged as such in the UI

_meta.does_not_affect: the six core COMPASS predictions (ECE, SVI, upgrade, PSM, BCR, LNI)

ns_base_model.citation: COMPASS zone-aware NS grade (MODEL_CARD.md §9); side ECE/SVI from the fitted COMPASS side-specific models (Mount Sinai RARP cohort, N≈5,352).

ns_minimal_disease.citation: Tewari 2012 risk-stratified nerve-sparing; Patel 2015 grade of nerve-sparing

ns_zone_thresholds_ece_fraction.citation: posterolateral/base from existing COMPASS NS_THRESHOLDS; apex/anterior/bladder-neck from zone-specific PSM literature (Preisser 2019; Martini 2017)

ns_zone_ece_fallback_split.citation: ECE-site distribution on whole-mount RP series (Martini 2017; Ball 2015)

gg_boost_zone.citation: monotone prior mapping biopsy GG (+ core involvement) to zone csPCa probability; expert prior pending COMPASS fitting

ns_alert_thresholds.citation: Preisser 2019 apical margins; Tewari 2011 NVB anatomy; PSMA-positive-at-base 43% ECE (Hofman 2020)

plane_technique.citation: Tewari 2011 anatomic fascial planes; Martini 2018 incremental nerve-sparing grades

inflammation_risk_weights.citation: Martini 2018; Mandel 2018 salvage RP; Cheng 2021 PPAT inflammation; Rud 2015 post-biopsy MRI change. BPH sub-weights ranked by dissection burden. Expert priors pending fitting against whole-mount inflammation grade.
inflammation_risk_weights.intraop_override: score = max(pre-op risk-factor score, intra-op-grade score); never de-escalates below the pre-op estimate

inflammation_tier_cutpoints.citation: provisional tertile-style cutpoints; to be calibrated against whole-mount inflammation grade + an intra-op difficulty score

hood_decision.citation: Rosenberg 2020 Cochrane; Menon 2018 RCT; Galfano 2013 Retzius-sparing technique

hydrodissection_threshold.not_applicable_when: frank EPE on imaging, or a planned grade-3 wide excision

functional_outcome_model.citation: COMPASS RARP functional-outcome working nomogram (Mount Sinai; ported from COMPASS_final.html); recovery-trajectory shape after Ficarra 2012 and Tewari 2012 systematic reviews. Not yet a formally published fitted model.

plan_functional_deltas_pp.citation: Rosenberg 2020; Menon 2018; Ma 2016; Patel 2012. Inflammation penalties are expert priors.

healer_threshold.citation: modeled potency ≥ 50% (PDE5-assisted) = functional recovery; to be calibrated against serial SHIM/EHS follow-up

nsg_outcome_data.citation: Mount Sinai 5,003-side RP database — PSM rate and BCR rate (margin- vs margin+) by NS grade and zone

psm_plan_modulation.citation: directional expert-prior adjustments to the NS-grade PSM rate
